questions.q: What requirement must two sets meet before you can combine them?
options: They must both be fixed sets, never dynamic
They must be based on the same dimension
One must be a group and the other a set
They must both contain exactly the same number of members
questions.explain: You can combine a customer set with another customer set, but not a customer set with a product set — both sets must be built on the same dimension.

questions.q: Which combine option returns only the members present in both source sets?
options: All Members in Both Sets
"Set A" except shared members
Shared Members in Both Sets
None of the options can do this
questions.explain: "Shared Members in Both Sets" is the intersection — only members that appear in both sets, useful for questions like "which customers purchased in both 2012 and 2013?"

questions.q: What does a Set Action let a viewer do?
options: Convert a fixed set into a calculated field automatically
Rename the underlying data source
Change which members are in a set live, by hovering, selecting, or using a menu on a mark in the view
Permanently delete a set from the workbook
questions.explain: A Set Action (Worksheet > Actions > Add Action > Change Set Values) lets an interaction on the view — hover, select, or menu — update a set's membership live, without editing the set's configuration manually.

questions.q: You want to find last year's customers who did NOT return this year. Which combine option gives you that?
options: Shared Members in Both Sets
This isn't possible with combined sets
All Members in Both Sets
"Last Year's Customers" except shared members
questions.explain: "Except shared members" removes anyone who's in both sets, leaving only the members unique to the named set — exactly the customers who didn't return.

questions.q: What does "set analysis" refer to in Tableau?
options: The general practice of using sets — plain, combined, or action-driven — as the building block for comparison and cohort questions and for click-driven interactivity
A type of calculated field only usable with LOD expressions
A feature exclusive to Tableau Server, not Desktop
A specific dedicated menu item called "Set Analysis"
questions.explain: "Set analysis" isn't one menu item — it's the umbrella term for using sets and combined sets to answer in/out comparison questions and to drive dashboard interactivity through Set Actions.
